public_brief: A museum is buying a complete set of replacement wayfinding panels before a busy weekend. Negotiate one total USD price, installation timing and the handover package.

turns.message: We reopen Friday, so Tuesday installation would give our team time to check the signs before visitors return. I can offer $1,750 total for the full set of replacement panels, Tuesday installation, and the editable source files. Would that work for you?
I can install the full set on Tuesday and hand over the editable source files that day. Can we settle at $1,925 total for that package?
Tuesday installation and same-day handover of the editable files work for us. Could we close at $1,850 total for the full set, with those terms?
Agreed. We’ll install the full set of replacement wayfinding panels on Tuesday and hand over the editable source files that day for $1,850 total.
